Ready to do "Besharmi Ki Height" with Varun and Ileana ? Watch this grooving number from the movie Main Tera Hero, It is composed by Sajid-Wajid and sung by Benny Dayal and Shalmali Kholgade.
Song: Besharmi Ki Height
Singer: Benny Dayal, Shalmali Kholgade
Music Director: Sajid Wajid
Lyricist: Kumar
Music Label: T-Series
Mixed and Mastered: Eric Pillai ( Future Sound Of Bombay)
Enjoy and stay connected with us!!
